channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Grayson Allen | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Grayson Allen from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Royce O'Neale on Grayson Allen, Jordan Goodwin, Mark Williams
item.description:
Royce O'Neale on Suns injuries as Mark Williams (foot), Grayson Allen (hamstring) and Jordan Goodwin (cal) are listed as questionable for tonight's Game 2 at OKC:

“It's basketball. Injuries happen. You don't want them to, but I think it's just how we bounce back from them. Guys working their way back. Doing all the extra work behind the scenes to come back. Staying healthy is a big part of it. Those guys taking pride coming back. Being able to want to play and then try to get to full strength.”

Royce O'Neale on Grayson Allen, Jordan Goodwin, Mark Williams, Apr 22, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Grayson Allen
item.description:
Mike Budenholzer on whether there's concern Grayson Allen's foot strain could be a bigger issue:

“Right now I would say no. I think we're hopeful that the next day or two or whatever, you know, short-term, that he will make progress and be good to go. But you’re just never sure.”

Mike Budenholzer on Grayson Allen, Mar 14, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Grayson Allen
item.description:
Mike Budenholzer on Grayson Allen's shoulder injury:

“I don't know the exact circumstances, but he played some 5-on-5 and scrimmaged whatever day that was 3, 4 days ago and got tangled up, got hit. There was something that happened in the scrimmage that kinda got worse overnight”

Mike Budenholzer on Grayson Allen, Jan 2, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Draymond Green, Grayson Allen
item.description:
On Draymond Green:

“When Draymond is at his best, it's a good balance between being ultra aggressive and being on edge and also just being a cerebral monster that he is.”

Kevin Durant on Draymond Green, Grayson Allen, Dec 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Josh Bartelstein on Bol Bol, Grayson Allen, Damion Lee
item.description:
“Players on our team from Bol Bol, Grayson Allen and Damion Lee, you’re seeing more and more players start their careers in the G League and grow, learn our system, learn how we want to play it, and one day contribute at the high-up stage of playing in NBA games,NBA playoff games and hopefully winning an NBA championship.”

Josh Bartelstein on Bol Bol, Grayson Allen, Damion Lee, May 23, 2024. Source: gophnx.com.

item.title: Royce O'Neale on Grayson Allen
item.description:
Royce O’Neale on fitting in with the Suns starters:

“I try to fit in with any group I’m in. It was great getting to start with Grayson being out, get him right. Whether I’m starting or coming off the bench, I’m still gonna play the same way”

Royce O'Neale on Grayson Allen, Apr 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Grayson Allen
item.description:
“She was talking to the whole team, to be honest. It didn’t seem like she singled out Grayson, but she supports our whole team.”

Kevin Durant on Grayson Allen, Jan 16, 2024. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Grayson Allen
item.description:
DeRozan on Allen skirmish:

“I felt a hit. It felt like I went across the middle in a football game and tried to catch a slot route.”

DeMar DeRozan on Grayson Allen, Dec 29, 2022. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Zach LaVine on DeMar DeRozan, Grayson Allen
item.description:
LaVine on the DeRozan-Allen skirmish:

“We know his track record. Pat got the foul but DeMar got elbowed in the back of the head. DeMar responded the right way. The next 20 minutes, you saw what happened.”

Zach LaVine on DeMar DeRozan, Grayson Allen, Dec 29, 2022. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Grayson Allen, Alex Caruso
item.description:
KC Johnson:Zach LaVine on Grayson Allen's big games after what happened during regular season with Alex Caruso:

“You gotta give him credit. He's hitting shots. Obviously, we know what happened. At the end of the day, it's basketball.”

Zach LaVine on Grayson Allen, Alex Caruso, Apr 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Tristan Thompson on Grayson Allen, Alex Caruso
item.description:
Tristan Thompson on Grayson Allen returning to United Center after injuring Alex Caruso earlier in season:

“Shit. Take one of my dawgs out like that, we going to have issues. We got to set the tone.”

Tristan Thompson on Grayson Allen, Alex Caruso, Mar 4, 2022. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Grayson Allen
item.description:
Donovan Mitchell:

“It’s definitely different but I’m going to miss my guys. I talked to all of them and I think it’s tough to see that in this business,especially with my guy Grayson (Allen) because this is his first time going through it. ... We’ve got Mike, Bojan, we’ve got Ed, and those guys are really key to what we’ve got going on and I’m excited.”

Donovan Mitchell on Grayson Allen, Jul 2, 2019. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Grayson Allen
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Lindsey on the draft:

“It got down to Grayson and one other player. We were holding our breath. There were two teams, very good teams, that were trying to move in front of us for Grayson's rights. We had a really good offer right after we selected him, but we wanted to hold on.”

Dennis Lindsey on Grayson Allen, Jun 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Grayson Allen
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Lindsey on whether Allen will help right away:

“We expect our three internal free agents back, hopefully. If that's the case, (Grayson)'s going to have to watch and learn and compete,and Quin's going to have to make decisions on who starts and who's in the rotation.”

Dennis Lindsey on Grayson Allen, Jun 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.
